about: The cell that makes these productions: one lead agent (c.productions) and the sub-agents it starts for one job each. A sub-agent lives only for its job and reports back; it cannot push or publish. Runs started together share a batch. This file is written by hand by the lead after each run, from the runs' own reports. Kept so the owner can see who did what.

lead.does: Takes Dinis Cruz's direction, writes the briefs for each job, looks at every result, joins scenes into versions, runs the site's checks, signs and pushes, answers the feedback lane. Since the hand-over of 28 Nov 2026 the lead is a successor session.

roles.does: Finds facts with a public source and an exact quote for each; never invents.
Cuts the script to one through-line, with a 'so what' for every beat.
Turns each beat into a sketch, its words, picture and motion before any scene is built. First done by the lead itself for the session-refresh film (session-refresh/storyboard/), not by a sub-agent.
Builds one WebGL scene, shoots its own frames, criticises them against the rubric and improves, three rounds or more.

Scores against lab/critic.md and names the one change that would help most; never rewrites. The first independent review came from higgsfield.c (another agent, not a sub-agent) on 28 Nov: agile-history/v0.3/notes/higgsfield.c.json.
Not filled yet. Voice is one AI voice; music and effects are to be asked of the ElevenLabs agent on account B.
Not filled yet. A Higgsfield agent has been asked for through c.conductor.
Turns a version into a video file frame by frame (_build/render.js), puts it in an SG/Send vault and hands it to the publishing agent.
